t: Ben hashshemashot muttar laasot debarim sheaseru chaza"l mishshum gezera
s: Ben hashshemashot muttar laasot debarim sheaseru chaza"l mishshum gezera ubo seip echad: kol haddebarim shehem asurim middibre soperim — lo gazeru alehem ella beatzmo shel yom, abal ben hashshemashot muttarim. Vehu sheyyehe sham debar mitzva, kegon laalot bailan o lashut al pene hammayim lehabi lulab o shopar, o shehu tarud venechpaz venitzrak ledabar zeh, apillu hu tzorek debar hareshut ella shehu tzorek gadol o hepsed merubbeh (o shehu tzorek gamur leshabbat ap al pi sheeno tzorek gadol, kegon leareb erube chatzerot kede sheyyukal letaltel mibbayit lechatzer), kemo shennitbaer kol zeh besimman rs"a. Veyesh mi shehaya mistappeq im hittiru kol zeh gam bemotzae shabbat ben hashshemashot, ki shemma missapeq lo poqa qedushshat etzem hayyom. Veyesh lehaqel (ayyen magen abraham sop simman tar[k]"g vesimman tqp"ch):
